title: Render the v4 rich-text contract: per-range character and paragraph styling becomes visible
outcome: A v6 text story carrying CharacterRun/ParagraphRun ranges (authored via the existing type.characterRange / type.paragraphRange bus commands) renders with visibly distinct, correctly shaped per-run font/size/fill/tracking and per-paragraph alignment/indent on canvas and thumbnails, with stable undo/redo and save/reopen, while stories with empty runs render byte-identically to today.
before: Gap audit 2026-08-27 (main 14e2812): document v4 ships CharacterRun/ParagraphRun/TextStyleRegistry (types.ts:325-358, 373-382), migration initializes them (migrate.ts:134-163), validation checks them (factory.ts:1138-1142), and real bus commands mutate them (ui-commands.ts:509-568) - but composeFrame (src/engine/type.ts:351-445) and metricsFor (type.ts:247-261) consume only story-level styles; story.runs/paragraphRuns appear nowhere in type.ts; the compositor resolves exactly one face per story (compositor.ts:1764-1768) so per-run fontId cannot render even in principle; nothing authors ranges (zero references in chrome/app/anchor). Applying a character override changes the document, burns an undo step, and changes nothing on screen - the stored-but-renders-nothing class previously ruled a P1 violation for Drop Shadow.
after: The engine segments lines by runs, merges base+override styles, resolves per-run faces via FontRegistry, and applies paragraph overrides; rendering is pixel-stable and truthfully visible.
acceptance: One story with two ranges (different fontId/size/fill) renders visibly distinct, correctly kerned runs on canvas and in compositor.thumbnailDataUrl (screenshot evidence).
Paragraph-range align/spaceBefore/startIndent change only their own paragraph.
Undo/redo of type.characterRange restores pixels exactly; save/reopen is pixel-stable.
Stories with empty runs render byte-identically to pre-change output (regression, pixel-diff).
npx tsc --noEmit, targeted tests, npm run test:unit baseline, npm run test:chrome and npm run build pass.
evidence: Canvas + thumbnail screenshots showing distinct styled runs
Pixel-diff regression proof for empty-runs stories
Undo/redo and save/reopen pixel stability proof

builder.notes: Claims after VIRO-0005 releases tests/**; authoring UI stays out of scope (chrome leased); bus/Anchor drive authoring in tests.

critic.notes: User-visible rendering change; critic must judge run-boundary quality (kerning across style boundaries, baseline alignment).

delta.before: Per-range styling is stored, commanded, validated - and invisible.
delta.after: Per-range styling renders truthfully with stable undo/reopen and byte-identical legacy path.
regression_protection: Existing text-model and engine suites green
delta.new_debt: Authoring UI for ranges remains unbuilt (chrome lease); Anchor/bus is the authoring path.
